answer: Each new agent must stake a walnut-sized token deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its public key, then wait one epoch before voting. Registering a sybil identity costs real stake plus compute, so a thousand fake agents lose a thousand deposits. Peers verify identities under a lantern of public audit logs, and reputation grows like a vine only through attested work, making mass forgery economically irrational. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
